releases.name: Tivano 2.5.27
releases.body:
[Download Tivano (.dmg, Apple silicon)](https://github.com/elijah7x/tivano/releases/download/v2.5.27/Tivano-2.5.27.dmg)

Open the DMG and drag Tivano to Applications. The Source code archives below are for developers, not app installers.

If Tivano 1.0.2 or earlier reports HTTP 403 while checking updates, install this DMG manually once. Later checks use public static feeds and do not require a GitHub login.

## English

## Bug fixes

- An Antigravity conversation that hit one error no longer fails every turn after it. agy keeps repeating a conversation's last error on every later turn; Tivano now judges each turn by what it actually streamed, so automatic retries and Continue work again, and a new error still fails the turn.

## 简体中文

## 问题修复

- Antigravity 对话出过一次错误后，之后的每一轮不会再全部被判为失败。agy 会在之后每一轮都重复这个对话上一次的错误；Tivano 现在按每一轮实际输出的内容判断，自动重试和“继续”恢复正常，真正的新错误仍会判为失败。

## Thanks

- No outside contributors.
